drafts.draft_en:
AI made making easy.

It didn't make caring easy.

Anyone can generate a song now.
Very few will sit with one for three weeks until it feels true.

The competition was never the tool.
It was always your attention span.
drafts.video_tip: Single take at your desk or keyboard. Open on a phone generating a track in seconds, then cut to you replaying the same eight bars by hand. Caption the last two lines.

drafts.draft_en:
Creative business has two honest lanes.

Be the one they can't replace.
Or be the one they can afford.

The middle, good and fairly priced and forgettable, is where talented people go broke quietly.

Pick a lane. Then raise the price or raise the output.
drafts.video_tip: Whiteboard or paper, three boxes drawn live: best, cheapest, middle. Cross out the middle on the last line. Under 25 seconds, burned-in captions.
drafts.pattern: don't be in the middle (Hormozi) + selling

drafts.draft_en:
The best gatherings I've hosted had nothing to do with the food.

Low voices.
Phones in a basket.
Someone allowed to be wrong without being corrected.

People forget the menu.
They remember feeling safe enough to say the real thing.

Host for that.
drafts.video_tip: Slow pan across a set table before guests arrive, phone basket in frame. Voiceover reads the post. End on the empty chairs filling up, if you have that footage.

drafts.draft_en:
If self-promotion feels cringe, try the alternative.

Your best work, unseen.
Your rent, unpaid.

Sharing isn't bragging.
It's how the right people find you.

Post the work. Name the price. Let them decide.
drafts.video_tip: Selfie video walking out of the studio holding a finished piece. Say it straight to camera in one take, then flip to show the piece with the price on screen.
drafts.pattern: self-promotion isn't cringe (Welsh) + sell to people who can pay (Hormozi)
